definition: An indicator someone wrote outside the built-ins, called by its file name with its own inputs and read one output buffer at a time.
boundaries: Names the MetaTrader habit only and computes nothing; in QMX the same idea is a plain-Python block with its own entry, code and tests.
recognition: A strategy that calls an indicator by file name instead of a built-in.

sources.quote: The function returns the handle of a specified custom indicator.
